recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. The substantive FHIR-31805 guidance is still correct, and the path-name corrections are necessary so implementers can apply that guidance against the current R5/R6 element names. Treat FHIR-29692 as related rename context rather than as independently decided here.
issue_request: FHIR-31805 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked why PackagedProductDefinition had two recursive package paths, requesting guidance that explains when each path should be used.
initial_application: FHIR#31805-tagged commits in 2021 added and refined the PackagedProductDefinition recursive-relationships guidance and related element definitions. The intended distinction remained present, but subsequent element renaming left stale package.* path references in current source.
additional_context: FHIR-29692 later renamed PackagedProductDefinition.package to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging, and the active StructureDefinition now defines PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.containedItem.item and PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.packaging. fhir.ini confirms the edited resource sources are in current build scope. BR&R minutes confirm the work group discussed and reworded FHIR-31805 guidance; no Zulip evidence was found that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed stale PackagedProductDefinition.package.* references to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.* in the recursive relationship guidance and in nearby MedicinalProductDefinition/ManufacturedItemDefinition text that points readers to the same PackagedProductDefinition packaging paths.

source/medicinalproductdefinition/structuredefinition-MedicinalProductDefinition.xml: updated the comprisedOf definition's see-also reference to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.containedItem.item.

source/manufactureditemdefinition/manufactureditemdefinition-introduction.xml: updated packaging-component guidance to use PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.packaging and corrected the resource-name spelling in that path.

related_jiras.note: Renamed PackagedProductDefinition.package to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging after the FHIR-31805 guidance had been added, which made the old path references stale.
